We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra to see C=O stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). But we need the molecule structure. No SMILES given. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be previous context? Not provided. We may need to request IR spectra to detect carbonyl peaks. But counting carbonyl groups from IR alone may be ambiguous but typical C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. Could be multiple peaks.

Better to get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That returns a string with peaks. Then count peaks in carbonyl region (190-220 ppm). Let's do that.
